oneLiner: Search still compounding 17% while Cloud grows 82%, wrapped in a $195-205B capex program and antitrust appeals; ~22x forward is the cheapest of the AI mega-caps.
thesis: Distribution is the moat: ~91% global search share, 2.5B monthly AI Overviews users, Gemini app 950M+ MAU. AI disruption fear persists but Search revenue accelerated to +17%.
Cloud is a second franchise: $24.8B in Q2 (+82%) at ~35% segment margin, gaining share on AWS/Azure with TPUs plus Gemini frontier models.
Earnings quality caveat: Q2 GAAP EPS $9.11 included ~$99B of equity-stake marks (Anthropic to $124.3B, SpaceX); core EPS ~$2.85.
Capex is the swing factor: FY2026 guide raised to $195-205B with more growth flagged for 2027; the market debits it against the multiple until AI revenue proves out.

latestQuarter.label: Q2 2026 (reported Jul 22, 2026)
points: Revenue $119.8B, +24% YoY (beat); operating income $40.8B, +30%; operating margin 34% (+2pp).
Google Services $94.5B (+15%); Search ~$63.3B (+17%); YouTube ads $11.1B (+13%); subscriptions/platforms/devices $12.9B.
Cloud $24.8B (+82%); Cloud operating income $8.8B vs $2.8B a year ago.
GAAP EPS $9.11 incl. ~$99B equity gains (Anthropic, SpaceX); ex-gains ~$2.85 vs $2.89 consensus.
FY2026 capex raised to $195-205B; stock fell ~5% after hours on the hike.

segments: Search ~53% of revenue; Cloud ~21% (now solidly profitable); YouTube ads ~9%; subscriptions/devices ~11%; Other Bets <1% (-$1.8B operating loss).
Gemini monetization: AI Mode >1B MAU; AI Overviews carry ads; AI Pro $19.99/mo, AI Ultra $249.99/mo; Gemini subscription revenue ~$1.2B in 2025 with ads reportedly coming in 2026.
competitive: ChatGPT ~900M weekly actives / ~1B app MAU; agentic browsers (Atlas, Comet) attack the Chrome funnel; Perplexity ~45M MAU.
Cloud share (Synergy Q1 2026): AWS 28%, Azure 21%, Google 14%, but GCP grew 82% vs Azure ~40%, AWS +28%.

Antitrust: search remedies finalized Dec 2025 (data sharing, 1-year default deal caps, no Chrome divestiture); Google appealed, DOJ cross-appealed seeking Chrome divestiture; DC Circuit late 2026/early 2027. Ad tech remedies (Brinkema) still pending as of Aug 2026.
moat: Search distribution at ~91% share, the Chrome/Android funnel, and the largest AI distribution surface in the world; Cloud adds TPU/Gemini infrastructure advantage; the $124B Anthropic stake is optionality on rivals' success.
risks: Capex escalation: $195-205B in 2026, rising 2027; depreciation and FCF compression if AI revenue lags.
Antitrust tail risk: DOJ cross-appeal keeps Chrome divestiture and Apple-deal termination alive; data-sharing remedies already arm rivals.
Ad tech: forced AdX/DFP divestiture remains possible.
AI query substitution normalizing 'asking a bot' over searching.
Earnings quality: $6.26 of Q2's $9.11 EPS was investment marks that can reverse.
1-year cap on default deals injects annual Apple renewal risk.
catalysts: Possible Gemini in-app ads launch; 2027 capex framing at year-end.
pricedIn: ~22x forward sits mid-range of the historical 18-24x band despite 24% growth: cheap vs Mag-7 AI peers, reflecting capex and antitrust discounts. Debate: is $200B capex offensive reinvestment justified by 82% Cloud growth, or margin-destroying overbuild; and does AI substitution eventually crack a Search engine that is still growing 17%?

scenarios.bear: Capex tops $205B and rises again while Cloud decelerates into a capacity glut; depreciation crushes margins; AI Overviews cannibalize paid clicks; DC Circuit reinstates structural remedies; Anthropic marks reverse. Mid-teens multiple on lower core EPS.
scenarios.base: Search grows low-double-digits with AI Overviews monetizing near parity; Cloud compounds 40-60%; appeals delay structural change through 2027; low-20s forward P/E on mid-teens core EPS growth grinds the stock higher with capex-headline volatility.
scenarios.bull: Cloud sustains 60%+ with margin expansion; capex proves supply-constrained, not speculative; Gemini layers ads and subscriptions into a second multi-tens-of-billions stream; courts uphold narrow remedies; re-rating toward 26-28x.

valPresets.note: Valuation basis is forward earnings: TTM FCF is crushed by the $195-205B capex program and TTM GAAP earnings are inflated by ~$99B of Anthropic/SpaceX marks, so forward EPS is the cleanest anchor.
